actions.name: assassinate
actions.desc: During its first turn, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} scores against a &reference[surprise]{Surprised} creature is a critical hit.

actions.name: evasion
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

actions.name: sneak attack
actions.desc: Once per turn, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} deals an extra [[/damage average]] damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} that isn't &reference[incapacitated apply=false] and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: shortsword
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. The target must make a [[/save activity=K4WCmn76MTQNDMpO]] saving throw, taking [[/damage activity=K4WCmn76MTQNDMpO]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
